facts.summary: Deprioritized ovarian and bladder programs, narrowing focus to endometrial cancer · Phase 2b · ACR-368 in ovarian/bladder/endometrial cancer · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Due to increased competition and a smaller market opportunity, the company set a high internal clinical bar for ovarian cancer, which preliminary data suggests is unlikely to be met
evidence.program_discontinued: Bladder cancer is also being deprioritized due to lower than preclinically predicted BM+ rate, leading to enrollment challenges
